newsitem.title: USA: Sportsman's Guide files for stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Sportsman's Guide files for stock offer.

text.p: Sportsman's Guide Inc, which sells outdoor, hunting and general merchandise by mail order, on Monday said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 2.0 million shares of common stock.

The company said it expected the offering price of the shares to be between $7.00 and $8.00 each. Of the shares being registered, 1,600,000 are to be sold by the company and 400,000 shares by certain shareholders.
In addition, the selling shareholders have granted an option to the underwriters to purchase up to an additional 300,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
The shares will be sold to the public through an underwriting group managed by John G. Kinnard and Co and Cruttenden Roth Inc.

The company said it intended to use the proceeds from the sale of its shares to repay subordinated notes payable, to repurchase shares of series A preferred stock and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
